title: Default 21-character URL-safe ID
summary: Generate one random 21-character URL-friendly ID (the Nano ID default) per call with the package's default secure generator.
notes: No cache or pre-generated pool is added: each call asks the library for a new ID. The packages may buffer entropy internally (npm nanoid fills a pool of random bytes and slices it). @sitnik/nanoid on JSR ships the browser build, which asks crypto.getRandomValues for 21 bytes on every call, and the Rust crate seeds a new StdRng from the operating system's random source on every call. All three are the libraries' defaults.
